initiatives.name: T-Time Transgender Support
initiatives.description: Peer support group in Myrtle Beach, SC, running since 2005, for transgender, intersex and non-binary adults, with separate youth and family groups. It serves Horry and Florence counties.

initiatives.name: Fyrebird Recovery
initiatives.description: Harm reduction nonprofit in Myrtle Beach and the only syringe services program in Horry County. It offers naloxone, safe-use supplies, case management, a food pantry and street outreach.
